# ORBIT assets

- Three.js 0.160.x, GLTFLoader and BufferGeometryUtils: MIT, copyright Three.js authors. See THREE-LICENSE.txt. Loader files from the official Three.js 0.160.0 npm distribution; import paths point to the local engine.
- Planet and cloud textures: Solar System Scope, CC BY 4.0, https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/. Original attribution remains in the footer.
- Earth normal and specular textures: Three.js examples, MIT.
- orbit-surveyor.glb: original ORBIT concept spacecraft, CC0-1.0. Generated by scripts/generate-craft.mjs. No third-party spacecraft design is claimed.
- UI fonts use the existing Google Fonts imports, with local system fallbacks.

The model importer supports self-contained, uncompressed GLB and glTF with embedded buffers/images. External resource URLs, Draco, and KTX2/Basis decoding are not enabled. Uploads are browser-local and limited to 15 MB. The included spacecraft is approximately 40 KB and loads only when its workspace becomes visible.
